request.reason: The unchanged cockpit-repository package test advanced but reached the 600-second node limit during host verification. Bound this WI's existing task-stage commands to at most 900 seconds per node; retain all tests, assertions, action permissions, and failed/Unknown receipts.

verificationRequirement.reason: Allow at most 900 seconds for existing WI-1121 task-stage verification commands after the repository package timed out at 600 seconds, without changing checks, safety assertions, permissions, or cleanup evidence.

acceptanceCriteria: The candidate source is exactly the merged main tree from PR #1079 plus declared v1.0.2 version and distribution documentation changes; source and release identities remain traceable.
Workspace manifests and current English, Japanese and Chinese install/version guidance consistently identify stable v1.0.2, while historical v1.0.1 facts remain historical.
Exact-head local verification and hosted Linux, Mac and Windows quality and release candidate checks pass; failed results remain visible.
A new annotated v1.0.2 tag is immutable and points to the admitted release source; no existing tag or asset is replaced.
Published archives for the declared supported targets match SHA256SUMS and release-manifest.json, with SBOM and provenance bound to the same source and tag.
Public install and v1.0.1-to-v1.0.2 upgrade acceptance use immutable downloaded artifacts and pass the Contract checks; cleanup and receipts are retained.
Release is reported only after the Runtime admits publication and post-release acceptance; unresolved historical cleanup Unknowns and unproved unmanaged descendant closure remain disclosed.
previousContract.goal: Advance workspace version and current distribution documentation to v1.0.2, pass exact-source repository and release gates, publish a new annotated immutable v1.0.2 tag and Release with checksums, manifest and SBOM, then verify published artifacts and upgrade from v1.0.1. Preserve all historical failed and Unknown evidence.
previousContract.intent: Publish stable AI Cockpit v1.0.2 from the verified main merge of PR #1079, with immutable multi-platform artifacts and honest install/upgrade acceptance evidence.
outOfScope: Historical WI evidence and cleanup Unknown remain immutable
Unrelated product or security behavior and global Agent settings are excluded
Existing tags Releases and immutable assets must never be overwritten
Publication requires current candidate acceptance and Runtime admission

scenarioCoverage.expected: The reviewed source, workspace manifests and current distribution guidance consistently identify stable v1.0.2 without altering historical v1.0.1 identities.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect exact main-derived source, Cargo metadata/lock and the current English, Japanese and Chinese distribution/version pages; require version and package identity consistency.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The v1.0.2 candidate passes all declared local checks and exact-head Linux, Mac and Windows hosted quality gates before publication.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Bind the candidate commit and tree to native verification, CI run and all required jobs; treat any source change or failed job as requiring fresh evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A new annotated v1.0.2 tag and Release publish four supported target archives with matching SHA256SUMS, manifest and SBOM only after candidate acceptance.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Check tag absence and exact commit identity, run the release workflow from v1.0.1 to v1.0.2, require candidate smoke for macOS arm64, Linux x86_64 and arm64 GNU, and Windows x86_64 MSVC, then verify immutable public assets and checksums.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Public install of v1.0.2 and v1.0.1-to-v1.0.2 upgrade pass from immutable downloaded artifacts with clean isolated run roots and current receipts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run declared post-release install and upgrade acceptance against published artifacts, retain digests, manifests, command output and cleanup evidence; do not substitute branch or local binary results.
